$comment: The repository's OWN label set, from three sources and never guessed -- nen refuses to guess a taxonomy, and a guessed one would report labels this repository does not have. The entries before the lang/ and job/ families were read from GitHub on 2026-10-12 with `gh label list` rather than authored by hand. The lang/ and job/ families are declared from Hatsu's classify taxonomy by `nen classify install --write` (hatsu:classify, the maintainer's rulings of 2026-10-04) and reach GitHub only through `nen classify install --sync` after this declaration lands on main. The model/ family (five lines: claude, gpt, gemini, grok, composer) is hatsu:direct's opt-in verdict label (nen/workflow.json -> direct.publish), declared here by hand from Hatsu's direct registry because nen's classify contract admits exactly two axes; it reaches GitHub through `nen labels sync` once this declaration lands and is applied only by hatsu:direct through `nen label apply`.
